about_the_game:
Dive into the seductive world of puzzles and anime aesthetics with Waifu Lust - a unique game for fans of puzzles and sensual anime art. Here you will find sexy and arousing heroines in a realistic style, each of whom is ready to open up to you, piece by piece.

Game Features

  • 30 levels with explicit puzzles

    Each level is a new illustration with charming girls in seductive outfits. The difficulty of the puzzles gradually increases, providing interest and challenge for both beginners and experienced players.

  • Gallery of collected illustrations

    Collected images are saved in a personal gallery, where you can enjoy your favorite girls at any time and track your progress. Create your own collection of passionate anime beauties.

  • Achievement system

    Get rewards for your success! Complete levels, open rare art and earn trophies that will make the game even more exciting.

  • Simple and convenient controls

    The interface is intuitive - just drag and drop elements and enjoy the process. The game is suitable even for those who are encountering the puzzle genre for the first time.

  • Atmosphere of passion and anime glamour

    Bright, rich graphics, erotic visuals and realistic style of anime girls make each level unique and exciting. Each waifu is a separate fantasy embodied in an illustration.

Who is this game for?

Waifu Lust is an ideal choice for lovers of puzzles, erotic art and anime. It's perfect for those who want to relax, have a good time, or just enjoy the aesthetics of passionate waifus.

Collect spicy puzzles, unlock new looks, earn achievements, and create your own gallery of sensual anime girls in Waifu Lust!

content_descriptors.notes: Anime girls in lingerie, naked girls with their genitals covered, and in explicit sexual positions, as well as direct references to sexual intercourse. The base game does not feature fully naked girls with exposed genitals.
